title: Atomic Bit Flags
goal: Set a flag bit atomically and detect if it was previously set.
hints: Atomic operations in Rust that mutate values start with the prefix `fetch_`.
Check whether the specific bit was non-zero in the previous value.
explanation: `fetch_or` performs a bitwise OR operation atomically and returns the PREVIOUS value of the atomic integer. Bitwise ANDing `(prev & FLAG_READY) != 0` checks whether `FLAG_READY` was already set before `fetch_or` executed. `or` does not exist on `AtomicU32` and causes `E0599`. `store` returns unit `()` and replaces the entire integer instead of setting specific bits, causing `E0369`. Equality check `prev == FLAG_READY` fails if other flag bits are set.
